title: connectDecart
responsibility: Connect canvas video through an injected safe transport with bounded lifetime and deterministic cleanup.

inputs.name: connectDecart.canvas
inputs.description: Browser canvas that receives the native scene or supplies game-only video frames.

inputs.name: connectDecart.session
inputs.description: Bounded ephemeral rendering session containing the selected model and maximum duration.

inputs.name: connectDecart.prompt
inputs.description: Visual prompt string or options including prompt, cancellation signal and injected safe connector.

inputs.name: connectDecart.onStream
inputs.description: Callback receiving the remote output stream after connection succeeds.

outputs.name: decartTransportReady
outputs.description: False until a credential-safe public provider transport has been configured.

outputs.name: connectDecart
outputs.description: Connected video lifecycle exposing stop, ended and prompt updates; rejects unavailable or failed transports.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: No safe connector is available, cancellation has occurred, or the video connection failed.
